definitions.gloss: to shrink; to atrophy; to wither
definitions.explanation: Physical shrinking, often used in medical or scientific contexts.

definitions.gloss: to feel intimidated; to cower; to lose confidence
definitions.explanation: Psychological shrinking, becoming timid or inhibited.

examples.japanese: {筋肉|きんにく}を{使|つか}わないと{萎縮|いしゅく}してしまう。
examples.english: If you don't use your muscles, they will atrophy.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}の{前|まえ}で{萎縮|いしゅく}してしまい、{意見|いけん}が{言|い}えなかった。
examples.english: I felt intimidated in front of my boss and couldn't voice my opinion.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{批判|ひはん}を{受|う}けて、チームの{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{萎縮|いしゅく}した。
examples.english: After receiving harsh criticism, the team's atmosphere became inhibited.

notes:
{萎縮|いしゅく}する is an intransitive する verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) with both physical and psychological meanings.

TWO MAIN USES:
1. Physical: Atrophy or shrinking of organs, muscles, or tissue
2. Psychological: Becoming timid, losing confidence due to pressure

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{筋肉|きんにく}が{萎縮|いしゅく}する - muscles atrophy
・プレッシャーで{萎縮|いしゅく}する - to feel intimidated by pressure
・{萎縮|いしゅく}せずに{発言|はつげん}する - to speak up without being intimidated
